 Dallas Mavericks vs Indiana Pacers Preview
 The Dallas Mavericks hit the hardwood against the Indiana Pacers in this NBA contest.
 The Mavericks opened the season with a 128-110 road loss to the Houston Rockets at Toyota Center. Cooper Flagg delivered an impressive performance with a game-high 32 points, but Dallas was unable to keep pace with Houston. Marcus Sasser contributed 17 points, while Naji Marshall added 16 as the Mavs suffered an 18-point defeat in their season opener.
 The Pacers tipped off the new season with a narrow 123-120 road victory over the New Orleans Pelicans at Smoothie King Center. Pascal Siakam led the way with 30 points, while Tyrese Haliburton recorded a double-double with 23 points and 12 assists. Obi Toppin chipped in with 20 points to help Indiana edge New Orleans.
 H2H: Mavs Won Last Meeting 134-130
 The Mavericks have won their last two meetings with the Pacers, securing a narrow 107-105 home victory at American Airlines Center before claiming a 134-130 road win at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. However, Indiana has held the upper hand in recent head-to-head matchups, winning six of the last ten games against Dallas.
